findings.title: Heuristic candidate: State Write Reachable After External Call (Mutex Proof Unavailable)
findings.impact: POTENTIAL IMPACT IF CONFIRMED: An attacker contract receiving the external call can invoke the vulnerable function recursively before the storage slot is updated, draining protocol balances.
findings.attackScenario:
UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: 1. Attacker calls victim contract withdraw function.
2. Victim sends ETH/tokens via low-level CALL opcode.
3. Attacker fallback/receive function is triggered and calls withdraw again.
4. Victim repeats balance transfer because SSTORE updating balance has not executed yet.
5. Entire contract balance is depleted in a single transaction.

proofOfConcept.summary: UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: UNEXECUTED test hypothesis: recursive call prior to SSTORE; validate target identity, storage dependency and mutex before confirming exploitability.

evidence.disassemblyContext: Represented CFG path block_7355 -> block_7447 -> block_7491 -> block_7519 reaches a state write after CALL; mutex, call target and path feasibility are not proved.

remediation.strategy: Enforce Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI) pattern or apply OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard.

limitations: No target exploit execution was performed by Full V2; static/heuristic evidence must not be presented as an active exploit.

findings.title: Heuristic candidate: Irreversible Single-Step Ownership Transfer Lacking Two-Step Confirmation
findings.impact: POTENTIAL IMPACT IF CONFIRMED: Directly passing an incorrect address or typo to transferOwnership immediately and permanently surrenders ownership without recourse.
findings.attackScenario:
UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: 1. Current owner executes transferOwnership to migrate governance to a cold multisig or timelock.
2. A typographical or copy-paste error targets an un-owned address.
3. Governance and administrative privileges are permanently frozen.

proofOfConcept.summary: UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: Single-step transfer irrevocably assigns state to dead address

sequence.expectation: Reverts: caller is no longer owner

evidence.disassemblyContext: Single-step transfer pattern identified without pending ownership two-step handshake.

remediation.strategy: Inherit OpenZeppelin Ownable2Step to require pending owner claim before role reassignment.

findings.title: Heuristic candidate: State Write Reachable After External Call (Mutex Proof Unavailable)
findings.impact: POTENTIAL IMPACT IF CONFIRMED: An attacker contract receiving the external call can invoke the vulnerable function recursively before the storage slot is updated, draining protocol balances.
findings.attackScenario:
UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: 1. Attacker calls victim contract withdraw function.
2. Victim sends ETH/tokens via low-level CALL opcode.
3. Attacker fallback/receive function is triggered and calls withdraw again.
4. Victim repeats balance transfer because SSTORE updating balance has not executed yet.
5. Entire contract balance is depleted in a single transaction.

proofOfConcept.summary: UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: UNEXECUTED test hypothesis: recursive call prior to SSTORE; validate target identity, storage dependency and mutex before confirming exploitability.

evidence.disassemblyContext: Represented CFG path block_8604 -> block_8619 -> block_8623 reaches a state write after CALL; mutex, call target and path feasibility are not proved.

remediation.strategy: Enforce Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI) pattern or apply OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard.

limitations: No target exploit execution was performed by Full V2; static/heuristic evidence must not be presented as an active exploit.

findings.title: Heuristic candidate: Irreversible Single-Step Ownership Transfer Lacking Two-Step Confirmation
findings.impact: POTENTIAL IMPACT IF CONFIRMED: Directly passing an incorrect address or typo to transferOwnership immediately and permanently surrenders ownership without recourse.
findings.attackScenario:
UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: 1. Current owner executes transferOwnership to migrate governance to a cold multisig or timelock.
2. A typographical or copy-paste error targets an un-owned address.
3. Governance and administrative privileges are permanently frozen.

proofOfConcept.summary: UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: Single-step transfer irrevocably assigns state to dead address

sequence.expectation: Reverts: caller is no longer owner

evidence.disassemblyContext: Single-step transfer pattern identified without pending ownership two-step handshake.

remediation.strategy: Inherit OpenZeppelin Ownable2Step to require pending owner claim before role reassignment.

limitations: No target exploit execution was performed by Full V2; static/heuristic evidence must not be presented as an active exploit.
CFG presence does not prove caller reachability or missing authorization.
SELFDESTRUCT effects depend on chain/fork semantics; after EIP-6780 it generally does not delete pre-existing code/storage unless executed in the creation transaction.

findings.title: Heuristic candidate: SELFDESTRUCT lifecycle/authorization surface
findings.impact: POTENTIAL IMPACT IF CONFIRMED: A reachable SELFDESTRUCT path can transfer the contract balance and has fork-dependent lifecycle effects. Authorization, reachability and exact chain semantics require separate proof.
findings.attackScenario: UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS: Determine the function/callback that reaches this opcode, prove its authorization conditions, and reproduce behavior on the target chain/fork before assigning exploitability.
